title: MTS Idioms: Set 1 (Q1 to Q28)
subtitle: Turn back the clock to Upset the apple cart

words.hindi: बीते समय में वापस जाकर गलतियों को सुधारना
words.meaning: To desire to go back to a previous point in the past to change or undo events or actions that are now regretted.
words.example: Каash hum apni purani galtiyon ko sudharne ke liye turn back the clock kar paate.

words.hindi: حساب बराबर करना / बदला लेना या स्थिति बराबर करना
words.meaning: To avenge a wrong or make an unfair situation more equal.
words.example: He wanted to win the next match to even the score with his rival.

words.hindi: जैसी करनी वैसी भरनी
words.meaning: People's actions have consequences that will eventually return to them.
synonyms: As you sow, so shall you reap
words.example: Never hurt anyone; remember, what goes around comes around.

words.hindi: सबसे पहले दोष निकालना या आलोचना करना
words.meaning: To be the first to criticize someone or something.
words.example: Before judging others' mistakes, make sure you don't cast the first stone.

words.hindi: अंतिम समय सीमा (Deadline) पर ठीक समय से पहले
words.meaning: Barely in time, at the last moment.
words.example: He submitted his online application form just under the wire.

words.hindi: बेहद भयानक और असहनीय स्थिति
words.meaning: A situation or experience that is extremely unpleasant.
words.example: Being stuck in a boring meeting all day feels like a fate worse than death.

words.hindi: उपस्थित रहकर या छोड़कर अपना विरोध जताना
words.meaning: Indicate an opinion by being present or absent (showing support or dissent by actions).
words.example: Unhappy customers voted with their feet and stopped buying the product.

words.hindi: तुरंत / बिना किसी देरी के
words.meaning: Immediately; straight away.
words.example: The manager asked him to complete the urgent file tout de suite.

words.hindi: कठिन समय में किसी की आर्थिक मदद करके पार लगाना
words.meaning: To help someone to work or operate normally through a difficult period, usually by lending money.
words.example: This small loan will tide me over until my salary is credited.

words.word: Have a whale of a time
words.hindi: खूब मज़ा करना / आनंद लेना
words.meaning: Enjoy oneself very much.
words.example: We went to Goa last weekend and had a whale of a time.

words.hindi: अत्यधिक शर्मिंदा या घृणित महसूस कराना
words.meaning: To give one an acute feeling of disgust, shame, embarrassment, or anguish.
words.example: His cringey speech on stage made everyone's toes curl.

words.hindi: परिस्थितियों को पूरी तरह पलट देना
words.meaning: To change or reverse something dramatically.
words.example: The captain's brilliant century helped India turn the tide of the match.

words.hindi: सभी आवश्यक शर्तों या मानदंडों को पूरा करना
words.meaning: To satisfy or fulfill everything that is necessary or desired.
words.example: This laptop ticks all the boxes for performance, battery, and price.

words.hindi: कठिन परिस्थिति में भी न हार मानने वाला मजबूत व्यक्ति
words.meaning: A person who is strong, resilient, and not easily defeated or discouraged.
words.example: She is a tough cookie who bounced back quickly after the failure.

words.word: To have a finger in every pie
words.hindi: हर काम में दखल देना या शामिल होना
words.meaning: To be involved in several different activities or enterprises at once, often in a meddlesome way.
words.example: He likes to have a finger in every pie, managing both finance and marketing.

words.hindi: किसी के घर या मेहमाननवाज़ी में ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा रुककर अप्रिय होना
words.meaning: To remain a guest in a place for too long, to the point where the host no longer wishes one to stay.
words.example: If you stay at your friend's house for a month, you will wear out your welcome.

words.hindi: हर फैसले के लिए माँ या पत्नी पर पूरी तरह निर्भर रहना (पल्लू से बँधा होना)
words.meaning: Excessively dependent on one's mother or wife for guidance and decisions.
words.example: He cannot make a single career decision because he is still tied to his mother's apron strings.

words.hindi: रिश्वत देना / पैसे देकर काम कराना
words.meaning: To pay someone money, especially as a bribe.
words.example: The corrupt official expected people to cross his palm with silver to clear files.

words.hindi: बिना किसी शर्त या बंधन के
words.meaning: An offer made without conditions or restrictions, requiring nothing in return.
words.example: She offered him financial help with no strings attached.

words.hindi: देर से ही सही, पर बात समझ में आ जाना
words.meaning: Said when someone suddenly comes to realize or understand something after a period of confusion.
words.example: He looked confused at first, but then the penny dropped and he smiled.

words.hindi: बने-बनाए काम में बाधा या नुक्स डालने वाली चीज़
words.meaning: A detrimental circumstance or detail; a small drawback that spoils success.
words.example: The trip was perfect, the only fly in the ointment was the bad weather.

words.hindi: चैतन्य या सतर्क व्यक्ति को धोखे में रखना / चौंकानी देना
words.meaning: To surprise someone who is normally alert, shrewd, or on guard.
words.example: It is very hard to catch a weasel asleep; he notices every small detail.

words.hindi: अत्यधिक भारी-भरकम धनराशि
words.meaning: An exorbitant sum of money.
words.example: Buying that luxury sports car cost him a king's ransom.

words.hindi: दिखावटी और भड़कीला आयोजन जिसमें सार कम हो
words.meaning: An overly elaborate presentation or event that lacks real substance.
words.example: The product launch was just a dog and pony show with no real upgrades.

words.hindi: मौका मिलते ही ज़िम्मेदारी संभालने के लिए तैयार रहना
words.meaning: To be ready and available to help or replace someone when needed.
words.example: The junior manager is waiting in the wings to take over the project.

words.hindi: दिखने में सीधा-साधा पर अंदर से खतरनाक (धोखेबाज़)
words.meaning: A dangerous person pretending to be harmless and friendly.
words.example: Be careful of his sweet words; he is a wolf in sheep's clothing.

words.word: Be past the point of no return
words.hindi: ऐसी स्थिति जहाँ से पीछे लौटना असंभव हो
words.meaning: To have passed the last opportunity to reverse one's actions or return to the starting position.
words.example: Once you launch the rocket, you are past the point of no return.

words.hindi: बने-बनाए काम को बिगाड़ देना
words.meaning: To do or say something to spoil a satisfactory plan or situation.
words.example: Everything was going smoothly until he spoke up and upset the apple cart.
